title: A Review of the Long Horizon Forecasting Problem in Time Series Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2506.12809v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The long horizon forecasting (LHF) problem has come up in the time series literature for over the last 35 years or so. This review covers aspects of LHF in this period and how deep learning has incorporated variants of trend, seasonality, fourier and wavelet transforms, misspecification bias reduction and bandpass filters while contributing using convolutions, residual connections, sparsity reduction, strided convolutions, attention masks, SSMs, normalization methods, low-rank approximations and gating mechanisms. We highlight time series decomposition techniques, input data preprocessing and dataset windowing schemes that improve performance. Multi-layer perceptron models, recurrent neural network hybrids, self-attention models that improve and/or address the performances of the LHF problem are described, with an emphasis on the feature space construction. translated_title: 时间序列分析中长程预测问题综述
translated_abstract: 长程预测（LHF）问题在过去约35年的时间里持续出现在时间序列文献中。本综述涵盖了这一时期内LHF问题的各个方面，以及深度学习如何融合趋势、季节性、傅里叶变换和小波变换的变体、误设偏差降低和带通滤波器等技术，同时通过卷积、残差连接、稀疏性降低、步幅卷积、注意力掩码、状态空间模型（SSM）、归一化方法、低秩近似和门控机制等架构创新作出贡献。我们重点介绍了能够提升性能的时间序列分解技术、输入数据预处理以及数据集窗口划分方案。文中描述了改进和/或解决LHF问题性能的多层感知机模型、循环神经网络混合模型以及自注意力模型，并着重讨论了特征空间的构建。消融实验在ETTm2数据集上的多变量（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本综述系统梳理了35年来时间序列长程预测（LHF）问题的发展，总结了深度学习如何结合趋势/季节性分解、傅里叶与小波变换以及卷积、注意力、SSM等架构创新来提升长程预测性能，并通过ETTm2数据集上的消融实验加以验证。
en_tdlr: This review surveys over 35 years of research on the long horizon forecasting (LHF) problem, summarizing how deep learning integrates trend/seasonality decomposition, Fourier and wavelet transforms, and architectural innovations such as convolutions, attention mechanisms, and SSMs to improve LHF performance, validated through ablation studies on the ETTm2 dataset.
